revisions.note: assign_op_pattern: fold self-referential v=v op e into v op= e
explicit_auto_deref: drop (*x) on .field/[i]/.0/method bases (Deref coercion re-adds)
assign_op_pattern: fold pure projection places (field/index/deref) -- structural place identity + purity walk
bool_comparison: fold cmp-vs-bool-literal -- identity / !name / exact integer predicate inversion; float-order and compound bool stay unfolded
field_reassign_with_default: fuse default-init struct locals with the adjacent field-store prefix into a functional-update literal (all-fields drops the base, shorthand when text==field)
missing_const_for_thread_local: const-block the Cell initializer when the init attr/type is provably const (literals, const arrays/aggregates, None/Some(fn); struct-default stays unwrapped)
assertions_on_constants: drop the vacuous assert!(true) null guard at emission (constant-false and non-constant flags keep firing; shared true constants still render for surviving consumers)
identity_op: render the lhs alone for shifts by a constant zero (bitfield offset-0 lowering); compound <<=0 and shared zero constants keep today's rendering
assign_op_pattern: look through the lost-copy pass-through let alias + commutative operand-1 fold (integer Add/Mul/And/Or/Xor, pure RHS; floats and places excluded)
